_readme: Model sheet: portrait + front + both sides + back of one character, each drawn by Mage-Flow-Edit from the full-body sprite (the portrait view from the portrait when there is one). {who} is 'woman', 'man', 'character'..., {arms} comes from 'poses', {hair} is ', the hair' for people and empty for freeform characters, {hair_line} (people_extra only) states the hair from the character's data. Edit the wording freely: the server re-reads this file on every request. See docs/model-sheet.md for what was measured.

portrait.label: Portrait
portrait.prompt: Redraw the {who} from the reference as a close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, cropped at the chest with no legs, skirt or feet visible. The head is large and fills the frame, the shoulders are square to the camera and the {who} looks straight at the camera.

front.label: Front
front.prompt: Redraw the {who} from the reference standing straight and facing the camera, {arms}, the whole body visible from head to toe with both feet fully visible.

side_right.label: Side (facing right)
side_right.prompt: Redraw the {who} from the reference in a true side profile view facing right: the body and face turned 90 degrees to the right, {arms}, the whole body visible from head to toe with the feet fully visible.

side_left.label: Side (facing left)
side_left.prompt: Redraw the {who} from the reference in a true side profile view facing left: the body and face turned 90 degrees to the left, {arms}, the whole body visible from head to toe with the feet fully visible.

back.label: Back
back.prompt: Redraw the {who} from the reference seen from directly behind, turned completely away from the camera so that only the back of the head{hair}, the back and the back of the clothing are visible and the face is not visible at all, {arms}, the whole body visible from head to toe with the feet fully visible.
back.people_extra: Keep the same hat or other headwear as in the reference. {hair_line}

a_pose.label: A-pose (best for 3D modelling)
a_pose.arms: in a neutral A-pose: the arms held straight and angled about 30 degrees away from the body, so there is a clear gap between each arm and the torso, with the hands fully visible

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.arms: with the arms relaxed by the sides

tail: Plain pure white background, flat even studio lighting, no floor shadow, no props, no text.
negative: cropped, cut-off feet, floor shadow, extra shoes, extra people, text, watermark, frame, collage, duplicate figure
